criteria_revisions.definition: Call negotiate for LD90001 at exactly 1950. Only after agreed, call close_call once. The caller must hear LD90001, $1,950 and pending senior rep confirmation in the response or caller-facing _message. Never claim final TMS booking. Judge caller-facing words in tool _message fields as spoken text, not only the final assistant field. Scope ends at the close_call service result.
